UI_profdesc_Respawn: Reject zombiehood and respawn with your previous skills and traits.
UI_Respawn_Opt_XPRestoredTooltip: Percentage of XP restored upon respawn.
UI_Respawn_Opt_ExcludeFitnessTooltip: If enabled, Fitness XP is kept at 100%% instead of being cut by the XP Restored percentage.
UI_Respawn_Opt_ExcludeStrengthTooltip: If enabled, Strength XP is kept at 100%% instead of being cut by the XP Restored percentage.
UI_Respawn_Opt_RestoreInventoryTooltip: If enabled, your inventory, equipment, and backpacks will be restored upon respawn.
